title: Zevulun ben Dan
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Kiddushin 30a](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.30a.3-4): Rav Yehudah said in the name of Shmuel, “Like Zevulun ben Dan, whose father’s father taught him Scripture, Mishnah and Talmud, halakhot and aggadot.” [Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Kiddushin.30a.3.1) explains that he was a student in their days.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital Kiddushin 30a paragraph fully writes Rav Yehudah reporting Shmuel and names Zevulun’s paternal grandfather as his teacher. This supports the contextual expansion of אר״י and the relationship direction. Rashi’s student gloss is Hyman’s report.

The linked Rashi describes him as a student in their days. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1071&lang=en) calls him Shmuel’s student. The Bavli specifically names his paternal grandfather as his teacher.
